evidence_items.explanation: DeepMind judged AlphaFold 3 suitable for release after assessing biosecurity risks. This earlier, application-specific judgment does not establish the prevalence of low-risk AI in October 2026 or absolute harmlessness.

The evaluation includes AlphaFold 3 and challenges reliance on these tools as biological threat filters. It limits a blanket safety inference but neither documents October 2026 harm nor refutes the existence of many low-risk applications.
